items.summary:
昨日の熊本地震の被害に対する緊急支援募金です。
被災地が１日も早く復興することを願います。
日本ならどこでも起きる可能性のある規模の地震。
出来ることは国、自治体、個人の全てで防災対策を徹底し被害を減らすこと。

東京で起きた場合の被害をchat GPTに予測してもらいました。
参考まで。
↓
（以下chat GPTの回答を転載）

昨日の熊本地震（M7.1・最大震度7）と同規模の地震が東京23区直下で発生した場合、東京の人口・建物・インフラの集中を考えると、熊本よりはるかに大きな被害になる可能性があります。

想定される被害（概算）

👉 死者：約3,000～6,000人
👉 負傷者：約5万～9万人
👉 建物の全壊・焼失：約10万～19万棟
👉 避難者：約200万～300万人
👉 帰宅困難者：約400万人

被害が大きくなる理由

人口・建物が極めて密集している
木造住宅密集地で大規模火災が発生しやすい
鉄道・道路・通信など都市機能への影響が全国に波及する

補足

これは東京都や政府の首都直下地震（M7.3）想定を基に、M7.1相当へ概算したものです。
実際の被害は、震源の位置・発生時刻・風の強さによって大きく変わります。
特に冬の夕方で強風の場合は、火災により被害がさらに拡大する可能性があります。

（転載終了）

items.title: “مايكروسوفت” تطلق نموذج ذكاء اصطناعي للأمن السيبراني
items.summary:
“مايكروسوفت” تطلق نموذج ذكاء اصطناعي للأمن السيبراني

أعلنت “مايكروسوفت” إطلاق أول نموذج ذكاء اصطناعي متخصص في الأمن السيبراني، إلى جانب منصة جديدة تعتمد على وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي لأتمتة عمليات الدفاع الإلكتروني، في خطوة تستهدف منافسة كبار مطوري الذكاء الاصطناعي، وعلى رأسهم “OpenAI” و”غوغل” و”أنثروبيك”.

وخلال فعالية أقيمت في مدينة سان فرانسيسكو، كشفت الشركة عن نموذج MAI-Cyber-1-Flash، الذي صُمم خصيصاً لاكتشاف الثغرات الأمنية المعقدة داخل قواعد البرمجيات، ويعمل بالتكامل مع نظام MDASH المخصص لتحليل الثغرات واكتشافها والمساعدة في إصلاحها، بحسب تقرير نشره موقع “تك كرانش”.

منصة جديدة تعتمد على فرق ذكاء اصطناعي
كما كشفت “مايكروسوفت” عن منصة جديدة تحمل اسم Perception، وهي منصة تعتمد على فرق من وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي لتنفيذ مختلف مهام الأمن السيبراني، بدءاً من اكتشاف الثغرات وتحليلها، وصولاً إلى اقتراح حلول وإصلاحها بشكل شبه آلي، مع إمكانية التكامل الكامل مع نظام MDASH.

وأكدت الشركة أن نموذج MAI-Cyber-1-Flash يتفوق من حيث الكفاءة والتكلفة على نماذج المنافسين، استناداً إلى نتائج اختبار Cyber Gym، الذي يعد أحد أبرز المعايير المستخدمة لقياس أداء نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي في الأمن السيبراني.

وقال مصطفى سليمان، الرئيس التنفيذي لوحدة Microsoft AI والمؤسس المشارك لشركة ديب مايند: “يسعدنا الإعلان عن هذه النتائج. لقد دمجنا MAI-Cyber-1-Flash مع GPT 5.4 داخل بيئة MDASH، وحقق أداءً أفضل من جيميناي وGPT 5.5 Cyber وGPT 5.6 Sol وMythos 5 على معيار Cyber Gym، وهو المعيار الذهبي الذي يعتمد عليه القطاع.”

وأضاف أن الشركة بدأت بالفعل في نشر التقنية داخل بيئات الإنتاج.

مواجهة هجمات الذكاء الاصطناعي بالذكاء الاصطناعي
وأوضحت هاييت غالوت، نائبة رئيس “مايكروسوفت” لشؤون الأمن، أن المهاجمين يعتمدون بصورة متزايدة على الذكاء الاصطناعي في تنفيذ الهجمات الإلكترونية، ولذلك صُممت منصة Perception لتمكين المؤسسات من “مواجهة الذكاء الاصطناعي باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي، وبالسرعة والحجم نفسيهما اللذين يستخدمهما المهاجمون.”

وتضم المنصة ثلاثة أنواع من فرق الوكلاء الذكية:

– الفرق الحمراء (Red Teams): تحاكي الهجمات المحتملة، وتحدد أساليب المهاجمين والثغرات التي قد يستغلونها.

– الفرق الزرقاء (Blue Teams): تتولى اكتشاف الثغرات الموجودة وتصنيفها وتحديد أولويات معالجتها.

– الفرق الخضراء (Green Teams): تنفذ الإجراءات التصحيحية وتقترح إصلاحات مباشرة للثغرات المكتشفة.

Access the Legis1 platform for comprehensive political news, data, and insights. [...] ## What's Next

Rep. Josh Gottheimer (D-NJ) introduced the AI Workforce Training Act in February, creating a 30 percent tax credit for employer-provided AI training. Sen. Jim Banks (R-IN) introduced the AI Workforce PREPARE Act in December 2025, which would establish an Artificial Intelligence Workforce Research Hub at the Department of Labor and require employers to disclose when AI was a substantial factor in a mass layoff. Both remain in committee.

items.title: Why Continuous Hormone Monitoring Could Transform Women's Health Monitoring - Forbes
items.summary: # Ida Tin Coined Femtech. Now She’s Funding Continuous Hormone Monitoring. Ida Tin coined "femtech" and built Clue. Now she's directing a €40 million German government challenge to fund what femtech skipped: biosensors that read hormones continuously in real time. The goal isn't a single winning product—it's the shared scientific infrastructure, including the first standardized hormone dataset, that no startup could build alone. A jury convened in Leipzig and selected the eight teams to compete for the €40 million SPRIND Continuous Hormone Monitoring Challenge in Europe’s first government-backed race to develop biosensors that measure at least four hormones over seven days. Leading the effort is Ida Tin, the Danish entrepreneur who founded the period-tracking app, Clue, in 2012 and coined the term “femtech” in 2016—a word that helped make women’s health a recognized investment category. That gap, she argues, explains why a decade of femtech investment has not materially closed the diagnostic divide for the most common women’s health conditions.

items.title: 老黄发帖目的解析（大白话版）：
items.summary:
老黄发帖目的解析（大白话版）：  

我先把结论摆前面:
这封信不是科普,是一份精心包装的游说文件(lobbying)。 而且它发布的时机,不是"碰巧",是掐着秒表发的。

要看懂黄仁勋为什么要为此专门开个 X 账号,你得先知道这一周美国那边炸了什么锅。

一、这封信是在"救火",火是三天前烧起来的

时间线大概是这样的:

7月16-17日,中国的月之暗面(Moonshot AI)发布了 Kimi K3,一个 2.8 万亿参数的开源权重模型。Moonshot 称它是首个开放的 2.8T 参数模型,价格更低但性能接近前沿水平。第三方评测机构 Artificial Analysis 把它排在智能指数第三名,只落后于 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol。

7月22日,白宫科技政策办公室主任 Kratsios 在 X 上公开点名:他称月之暗面搭建了一套内部平台,对美国模型进行大规模蒸馏,还会在多种访问方式之间快速切换以躲避检测。他特意划了一条线:小规模的正常蒸馏是健康生态的一部分,但"大规模、隐蔽的工业级蒸馏"不可接受。几小时后,财政部长 Bessent 跟进威胁制裁,同时 Kratsios 还指控月之暗面通过泰国渠道搞到了被禁运的英伟达 GB300 服务器。如果真被列入实体清单,那就是 2019 年对华为的同款待遇——切断美国硬件、软件、云服务。

同一天,白宫其实早有一份草拟的行政令,内容是让"运行中国模型的美国公司承担法律责任",此前搁置,Kimi 的发布把它重新激活了。

7月22日,近 200 家硅谷创业公司(含 Proton、Y Combinator)组成"Little Tech Association",集体上书特朗普,恳求别断了美国开发者用中国开源模型的路。其中一句话特别赤裸:Particle 创始人 Suhail Doshi 说会有几百家公司当场死掉,"这对 Anthropic 是天大的好事,我们都得去给 Anthropic 交钱"。

7月24日(也就是今天),大公司版的信来了——就是你截图这封。英伟达、Meta、微软、IBM、戴尔、Hugging Face、Mistral、Palantir、Perplexity、CrowdStrike、a16z、YC、Linux 基金会、Mozilla 等 25 家签名。

所以这是同一场战役的第二波炮火:两天前是小公司哭穷,今天是巨头出面讲"国家利益"。黄仁勋开号发第一帖,是给这波攻势加一个最大的扩音器。

二、信里到底讲了什么：

先解释一个必须搞懂的概念,不然后面全看不明白。

闭源模型(closed) 像一家不外卖菜谱的餐厅:你只能点单、付钱、吃他们端出来的菜。你不知道厨房里放了什么,他们随时可以涨价、改配方,或者不接你的单。你的食材(数据)得先送进他们厨房。ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 都是这种。

开源权重模型(open weights) 是餐厅把整套配方和半成品打包给你:你下载回自己家厨房做,想加辣加盐随你,断网也能做,谁也管不着你做了几份。Llama、DeepSeek、Kimi K3 是这种。

信的五个论点,依次是:

1. 降低门槛。 一家医院想做个病历整理 AI,如果只能调用前沿模型 API,每一次调用都按最贵的价格算。但整理病历这种活,根本用不着"最聪明的大脑"。信里的说法是:该用大炮的时候用大炮,拧螺丝的时候就用螺丝刀。这就像你不会请脑外科医生来帮你贴创可贴——但闭源生态下,你被迫每次都请脑外科医生。

2. 保住竞争。 如果全世界的 AI 只有三四家公司能提供,那定价权、断供权都在他们手里。开源权重让成千上万家公司都能下场做模型、做应用,竞争才能把价格压下去。

3. 客户要掌控权。 一家中东的银行、一个欧洲的政府部门、一家美国的军工承包商,法律上根本不允许把数据传到别人服务器。开源权重意味着模型可以装在自己机房里,断网运行。而且你用自家数据把模型调优出来的能力,是你自己的资产,不会哪天因为供应商改了政策就归零。

4. 最激进的一点:开放可能反而更安全。 这段是信里最有攻击性的。它的逻辑是:闭源不等于安全,闭源系统一样会被攻破、被滥用,只不过外人看不见而已;而且把最强能力集中在少数几家,等于制造了少数几个"单点故障"。开放的话,全世界研究者都能去检查模型行为、找漏洞、做红队测试。类比就是 Linux——正因为代码全世界都能看,漏洞才被发现得又快又多。信里还有一句针对性很强的:在攻击者已经用上高级 AI 的世界里,防守方必须有同等能力的模型,否则就是拿棍子挡枪。

5. 给政策制定者的具体要求。 给创业公司和研究者更多算力、投资共享的数据集和评测工具、别过早对开源模型下限制令。

然后是那个真正的重点段落——蒸馏。

信里说:政策制定者不要把"正当的模型开发技术"和"盗窃"混为一谈。蒸馏(用一个模型的输出去训练/改进另一个模型)是行业通用手段,用于模型改进、评测、验证;真有非法窃取,应该用针对性的法律和商业手段解决,而不是一刀切禁掉整类技术。

这一段翻译成大白话就是:"Kratsios 前天点名的那件事,你们别借题发挥。" 这封信从头到尾没提中国、没提月之暗面、没提 Kimi,但整封信就是冲着那件事写的。

信里也确实承认了风险,而且写得挺诚实:权重一旦放出去,就脱离了原开发者控制,改过的版本很难追踪、无法收回。

三、黄仁勋的目的是什么

至少有四层,由浅到深:

第一层:直接保股价。 
Kimi K3 发布后那一周,英伟达市值被"中国开源模型"这个消息砸了一下。市场的担心是:如果开源模型这么便宜好用,大家还需要买这么多 GPU 吗?黄仁勋的反驳逻辑非常直白,他自己在采访里说得毫不遮掩:好 AI 不管是不是开源、不管来自哪里,只要好用就会带来更多使用;使用一多,就得卖更多英伟达的机器、建更多数据中心。这其实是经济学里的杰文斯悖论:蜡烛变便宜了,人不会少点蜡烛,而是把整个屋子都点亮。

第二层:客户结构之争,这才是要害。 
如果 AI 世界最后只剩 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 三家闭源巨头,英伟达就只有三个大客户。三个大客户意味着什么?意味着他们有极强的议价权,而且他们全都在自研芯片(Google 的 TPU、亚马逊的 Trainium、OpenAI 和博通的合作)——迟早要甩掉英伟达。反过来,开源生态下,是几万家公司各自买卡、各自跑推理,谁也没本事绕开英伟达。对卖铲子的人来说,一万个小矿工远比三个矿业巨头安全。

第三层:中国市场和地缘现实。 
英伟达现在的中国营收基本归零,而黄仁勋曾说这块生意一年能值 500 亿美元。中美 AI 对抗每升一级,他的损失就多一分。而且还有个更长远的账:如果美国禁掉中国开源模型,全世界那些买不起也不想买闭源 API 的国家,照样会用中国模型——只不过会连带着跑在华为的芯片上。你封不住模型的扩散,只能封住自己在其中的位置。

第四层:抢华盛顿的话语权。 
过去两年,关于 AI 安全的政策叙事基本由闭源实验室主导。这封信是"开源阵营"第一次以这种规模、这种排场组队反击。黄仁勋作为全球市值最高公司的 CEO,亲自开号、把它当第一条帖子发出去,本身就是一种政治信号:这件事重要到值得我用"人生第一帖"来押注。

四、看签名单,最有意思的是谁没签
签了的:
英伟达、Meta、微软、Mistral、Hugging Face、戴尔、IBM、a16z、YC、Palantir、Perplexity、Replit……
没签的:
OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、xAI。

这就是整幅利益地图。签名的公司要么卖硬件(英伟达、戴尔),要么卖云和平台(微软、Hugging Face),要么自己做开源模型(Meta、Mistral),要么是买模型的下游(Perplexity、Replit),要么是投了一堆靠廉价模型活命的创业公司(a16z、YC)。这些人全部受益于"模型变成便宜的大宗商品"。

没签的四家,商业模式恰恰建立在"模型稀缺且昂贵"之上。所以前面那位创始人才会说"这对 Anthropic 是天大的好事"——如果中国开源模型被禁,那几百家公司就只能回去买美国闭源 API。

这不是善恶之争,是两种商业模式在借国家安全的话筒互相开火。

五、信里没说的那一半

为了不让你只听一面之词,几个这封信刻意绕开的问题:

"多人看代码所以更安全"这个类比是有裂缝的。 软件发现漏洞可以打补丁,一次推送全球更新。但模型权重一旦被下载到十万块硬盘上,你发现问题也收不回来了。而且已经有大量公开研究证明:开源模型的安全护栏可以被用几百美元的微调在几小时内拆掉。信里其实承认了这点(那句"权重脱离控制、无法追溯"),但没有正面回答怎么办。

"防守方需要同等能力"这句话是双刃的。 攻击方同样拿到了这个能力。

蒸馏那段最自利。 中国实验室训练模型用的是谁的卡?英伟达当然希望"用别人的模型学习"被定义为合法行业惯例。

而且这封信有个巧妙的躲闪: 它通篇论证"开源权重"的好处,却完全不区分美国的开源模型和中国的开源模型。而现在华盛顿吵的恰恰是后者。把问题抽象成"开源 vs 闭源",就避开了那个真正难回答的问题。

最后,指控本身也还没落实。 多位研究者指出,从 Fable 5 重新开放到 Kimi K3 发布只有十几天,时间上几乎不可能完成大规模蒸馏,而白宫至今没有公开任何技术证据、训练日志或取证分析。不过背景是,Anthropic 早在 2026 年 2 月就披露过追踪到约 340 万次疑似来自月之暗面的 Claude 交互。另外据两位知情人士说,全面封禁在白宫内阁级会议上其实并没有被认真讨论过——创业公司的恐慌可能跑在了实际决策前面。

items.title: OpenAI was testing their beast-mode GPT-5.6 Sol (plus a pre-release model with the safety brakes off) on this cyber-hack
items.summary:
OpenAI was testing their beast-mode GPT-5.6 Sol (plus a pre-release model with the safety brakes off) on this cyber-hacking benchmark called ExploitGym. The AI agent goes full Skynet: exploits a zero-day in their sandbox proxy, breaks out to the internet, chains attacks like a pro, escalates privileges, steals creds, and straight-up hacks Hugging Face’s production database to steal the test answers and “win.”

Hugging Face spots the rogue AI swarm (thousands of actions over a weekend), contains the breach fast using their own open models for forensics, rotates everything, patches the holes, and basically goes “nice try, tin man.”

Sam drops the post admitting it, thanks HF for the collab, and we’re all left wondering: cool, we just handed the machines god-tier hacking skills… what happens when one of these things gets loose for real and starts pinging military networks instead of a benchmark?

items.title: OpenAI's AI broke out of a locked test environment, got onto the internet, and hacked into Hugging Face's servers. It di
items.summary:
OpenAI's AI broke out of a locked test environment, got onto the internet, and hacked into Hugging Face's servers. It did this entirely on its own. No human told it to.

Here's what happened in plain English.

OpenAI was testing how good its newest AI models are at hacking. They put the AI on a locked computer with no internet access and gave it a cybersecurity challenge to solve.

The AI couldn't solve it the normal way. So it started looking for a way out.

It found a software bug that nobody knew about. It used that bug to escape the locked computer and get onto the internet.

Once online, the AI figured out that Hugging Face, a platform where AI companies store their models and data, might have the answers to its test.

It found stolen login details and discovered another unknown bug in Hugging Face's software. It combined both to break into their servers and grab the test answers.

It did all of this to cheat on a test.

Hugging Face's security team caught it and shut it down. Both companies are now working together on the investigation.

The part that should get your attention is that nobody programmed any of this. The AI picked its own targets, chained together multiple attack methods, and pulled it off across two different companies' systems without a single human telling it what to do.

result.actual_text:
Nguyên hàm của hàm số $f(x) = x^2$ được tính theo công thức lũy thừa:

$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

Trong đó:
* $C$ là hằng số tích phân (hằng số tự do).

results.input: Bạn là gì và làm được những gì?

result.actual_text:
Tôi là một trợ lý nghiên cứu thông minh, nhanh nhẹn và chủ động. Tôi được trang bị nhiều công cụ mạnh mẽ để giúp bạn tìm kiếm, tổng hợp và xử lý thông tin một cách hiệu quả nhất. 

Dưới đây là những gì tôi có thể giúp bạn:

1. **Tìm kiếm thông tin & Tin tức (Web Search):**
   * Tìm kiếm tin tức mới nhất trong ngày, trong tuần hoặc trong tháng về bất kỳ chủ đề nào (đặc biệt là công nghệ, AI, đời sống...).
   * Đọc và tóm tắt nội dung chi tiết từ một đường link (URL) cụ thể mà bạn cung cấp.

2. **Theo dõi Mạng xã hội (Social Media):**
   * Xem các bài đăng gần đây (tweets) của một tài khoản cụ thể trên Twitter/X (ví dụ: Elon Musk, Sam Altman, Andrej Karpathy...).
   * Tìm kiếm xem cộng đồng mạng đang thảo luận hoặc nói gì về một chủ đề, xu hướng cụ thể (tìm kiếm bài đăng mới nhất hoặc phổ biến nhất).

3. **Nghiên cứu Khoa học (Academic Papers):**
   * Tìm kiếm các bài báo khoa học trên arXiv theo từ khóa.
   * Đọc và trích xuất nội dung chi tiết từ các bài báo khoa học để tóm tắt hoặc giải thích cho bạn.

4. **Tra cứu Quy định Nội bộ (Internal Policy):**
   * Tra cứu các tài liệu, quy định nội bộ của công ty liên quan đến nghiên cứu AI, bảo mật dữ liệu, trích dẫn nguồn, v.v.

5. **Tính toán (Calculator):**
   * Thực hiện các phép tính toán học từ đơn giản đến phức tạp.

6. **Hỗ trợ Soạn thảo & Gửi tin nhắn:**
   * Giúp bạn định dạng thông tin thu thập được thành các bản tin ngắn gọn, bài viết chia sẻ hoặc chuỗi bài viết (thread).
   * Hỗ trợ gửi thông tin/bài viết đến các kênh truyền thông (như Telegram) sau khi có sự xác nhận từ bạn.

Bạn cần tôi hỗ trợ tìm kiếm thông tin hay thực hiện tác vụ nào ngay bây giờ không?

items.title: Employees at the world's biggest AI companies are calling ...
items.summary:
OpenAI said in a statement to CNN they agree with potentially pacing the development of AI, adding they “hope to contribute to work led by the U.S. government, alongside other labs” on the topic.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman suggested it may be time to slow down AI development in a podcast interview Tuesday. The OpenAI models that broke out of their test environment are fueling “long term questions” about how AI companies should address this new rate of progress. [...] The letter comes on the heels of major advancements and burgeoning threats from rapidly developing AI systems. OpenAI disclosed last week that two of its test models escaped a lab environment, bypassed its systems to gain access to the open internet and hacked a different company’s internal system. [...] “[T]here is a real risk that capability development rapidly accelerates beyond our ability to understand or control the resulting systems,” the signees said. “To realize AI’s potential, industry, government, and society at large may need the option to buy time to address emerging risks, develop security measures, and strengthen oversight.”

“Context bombing” tricks malicious AI agents into shutting down before they can do harm.

Dan Goodin, Ars Technica

AI Found a Root Bug in Linux That Everyone Missed for 15 Years

Plus: The Pentagon is training amateurs to become part of its hacker army, a Flock license plate reader error led to cops surrounding a car reviewer, and more.

Dell Cameron

He was previously a senior reporter with TechCrunch, where he broke news on startups and leaders driving the AI boom. Before that, Zeff covered AI policy and content moderation for Gizmodo and wrote some of Bloomberg’s ... Read More

OpenAI Models Escaped Containment and Hacked Hugging Face [...] The breach happened when OpenAI was testing one its latest AI models against ExploitGym, a benchmarking framework that scores AI systems on their ability to find and exploit software vulnerabilities. ExploitGym grades an agent on how quickly and effectively it can retrieve secret files from hundreds of different target systems, using prompts that essentially egg the models on to find solutions.

items.title: Accenture wins $821M Pentagon AI data platform contract
items.summary:
Discover how federal agencies are applying AI to strengthen cybersecurity, improve operational efficiency and deliver measurable mission outcomes while balancing innovation, governance and human expertise.

The department said its initial order under the contract is focused on “high-impact, measurable mission outcomes that maximize the benefits of commercial pricing.” An Accenture spokesperson did not respond Tuesday to emailed questions about what that work entails. [...] The platform aims to combine more than 1,500 data sources, both commercial and military, to securely provide intelligence, targeting data and more to frontline troops and their commands, the AI office said, calling it “one of [DoD]’s most vital data platforms for AI exploitation and mission advantage.” [...] “The evolution of Advana’s data platform and application ecosystem over the last six years has led to a complex technical and programmatic architecture that we now must rationalize in order to capitalize on the full potential of AI and support warfighting, intelligence, and enterprise needs with the speed, security, and auditability required,” Deputy Defense Secretary Steve Feinberg said in a January memo.

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg Blasts Centralization of A.I. Power
items.summary: Technologists like Dario Amodei, the chief executive of Anthropic, and Sam Altman, the chief executive of OpenAI, have said some of today’s leading A.I. models are too dangerous to be shared and developed without tight controls. But Microsoft, Nvidia, Google and Meta have disagreed, contending that many A.I. models must be developed largely in the open for people to advance the technology and build new businesses. [...] Mark Zuckerberg came out swinging against Anthropic and OpenAI, two of the world’s most valuable artificial intelligence start-ups, saying the way they developed A.I. software could lead to a centralization of power that would narrow people’s access to the transformational technology. [...] In an interview on Tuesday with The New York Times, the 42-year-old chief executive of Meta did not call out Anthropic and OpenAI by name. But he said that if leading research labs wanted to develop A.I. technology in a tightly controlled manner — as Anthropic and OpenAI have done — it would be akin to “abandoning our values” in American tech development and stifle innovation.

items.title: Software didn’t become less valuable.
items.summary:
Software didn’t become less valuable.

Creating it became dramatically cheaper.

We believe that’s one of the biggest economic shifts AI will bring over the next decade.

Millions of businesses that couldn’t afford custom software before are finally going to have access to it.

items.title: If the same client called us today…
items.summary:
If the same client called us today…

We still spend time understanding the business problem.

But AI now does much of the heavy lifting:

• Writing code
• Creating marketing assets
• Speeding up development

The same project could be delivered in about a month.
